latest_release.name: v0.5.1
latest_release.body:
## What's New in v0.5.1

Three weeks of fixes for the desktop app: the AI works on the page you are viewing, a style button sits next to the selection, PDF export keeps the crop size on Windows, every answer shows its tokens and time, and models can think or not by a switch. It also brings the security updates of Electron 42.

### New Features

- **Style button next to the selection**: a brush button next to the selected shapes opens draw.io's format panel, for changing colors, lines and text by hand. With the chat panel hidden, a sparkle button next to it opens the panel to ask the AI (#1039)
- **Tokens, time and estimated cost under each answer**: hover the numbers for the details, such as how much input was read from the cache (#1016), and an estimated cost priced from models.dev (#762 by @Zhangxiaoyi688)
- **Thinking switch**: models whose API can turn thinking on or off get a switch in the model settings (#911 by @lq-kiren)
- **Named styles**: the model defines a style once and draws with it by name, instead of repeating the same style string on every shape (#969)
- **Models that cannot read images are marked** in the settings, with a warning when an image is attached to one (#1018)
- **MCP server card on the start screen**, with a short video, and a docs button (#990, #991, #1010)

### Improvements

- **The AI reads and draws the page you are viewing** in a multi-page diagram, instead of always the first page (#974)
- **The canvas goes with a message only when the model needs it**: earlier messages stay unchanged, so prompt caching works, and hand edits made between answers are no longer turned back (#1024)
- **Saved prompts fill the message box** instead of sending at once, so they can be changed first (#1036)
- **Pictures in the diagram reach the model as short references** instead of thousands of characters of image data (#1007)
- **Time so far while a model draws without streaming** (#1011)
- **Fixes from a user simulation**: the "changed by AI" outline fades after a few seconds, Enter sends, saved diagrams are one click away, PNG export is 2x on white with a margin, and each edit's reply says what changed (#996)
- **New app icon** (#985)
- **MiniMax**: current text models suggested (#1026 by @octo-patch)

### Bug Fixes

- **PDF export on the desktop**: Export in the PDF dialog saves the PDF directly with the diagram's own page size, so Crop no longer adds large margins and wide diagrams are no longer turned 90 degrees on Windows (#1038)
- **Shapes stay on their layer** when the AI edits a page whose other layer comes first in the file (#1037)
- **Custom data on shapes** is kept on their `<object>` wrapper (#1017)
- **Retries, stops and cut-off answers**: a retry after a tool error sends the current canvas, Stop also ends the screenshot check and the connection test, and an answer that ran out of output tokens before drawing says so with a Retry button (#987)
- **The daily limit message** no longer crashes the page (#1006)

### Security

- **Credentials**: the Test and model list endpoints refuse credentials that are not text (#1021)
- **Dependencies**: Electron 42 (#1029, after Electron 41.10.7 in #973), `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.32.0 (#1028), `@opennextjs/cloudflare` 1.20.2 (#1000), `proxy-addr`, `shell-quote` and `wrangler` (#971)

### MCP Server (0.4.1 to 0.4.7)

- **The preview is the web app's canvas**: version cards, compare and restore, and `get_selection` for "this box" (#984)
- **Saved sessions**, `restore_version` and the history on disk (#981); a screenshot attached to `create_new_diagram` and `edit_diagram` results on request (#983)
- **`load_diagram`** opens `.drawio.svg` files (#982) and accepts inline `xml` (#946 by @caoxiaole07); a summary of the user's hand changes, an XML reference by topic and preview options (#982); drawing guide hints and your own drawing rules (#980)
- **Install**: one-click install for VS Code and Cursor, and a Gemini CLI extension (#1015); the Windows preview opens withou

# Next AI Draw.io **Draw and edit draw.io diagrams by chatting with an AI.** English | [中文](./docs/cn/README_CN.md) | [日本語](./docs/ja/README_JA.md) [![TrendShift](https://trendshift.io/api/badge/repositories/15449)](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/) [![License: Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0) [![Sponsor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sponsor-❤-ea4aaa)](https://github.com/sponsors/DayuanJiang) [**Live Demo**](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/) · [**Docs**](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/en/docs) · [**Gallery**](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/en/gallery) · [**Desktop App**](https://github.com/DayuanJiang/next-ai-draw-io/releases) · [**MCP Server**](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/en/mcp)
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/66b9f12f-219f-4d62-acc0-0725e6850eec Describe a diagram in a sentence and the AI draws it on a real draw.io canvas. Edit it by hand like any draw.io file, or select a few shapes and tell the AI what to change. Every AI change is a version you can compare, restore or undo, and the result exports as `.drawio`, `.png` or `.svg`. Available as a web app, a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, and an MCP server for AI agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code. ## Highlights **Draw** - Architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams and more from one sentence, with built-in AWS, Azure, GCP and Kubernetes icon libraries - Connectors can carry a flowing animation - Upload a screenshot or a sketch and the AI redraws it; upload PDF, Markdown, code and other text files and get a diagram of their content **Edit** - Edit by chat: changes stream onto the canvas and the shapes the AI just changed are highlighted - Ask about a selection: select shapes on the canvas and the AI changes only those - Versions and undo: every AI change is a version card with a thumbnail; compare it with the canvas, restore it or undo it, and Ctrl+Z on the canvas also takes back an AI change in one step - It is a normal draw.io diagram: double-click to rename, drag, restyle, use several pages, and export as `.drawio`, `.png`, `.svg` or `.drawio.svg` at any time **Use** - 25 model providers, including an OpenAI-compatible preset for any other URL; enter your own API key in the browser and it stays on your machine - Models that reason show their thinking - Dark mode; the interface is available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese ## Examples
Highly available web app on AWS

Prompt: Draw an AWS architecture for a highly available web app across two Availability Zones with AWS icons: Route 53, CloudFront with AWS WAF, an Application Load Balancer, ECS Fargate services in private subnets, Aurora PostgreSQL with a writer and a reader, ElastiC
